question: In the morning, a parking garage has 124 cars parked inside. By midday, 51 cars leave as their owners head to lunch meetings downtown. In the early afternoon, a nearby stadium event brings the garage's count to 2 times what remained. By late afternoon, a second wave of event traffic brings the count to 6 times what it had grown to. By evening, a final rush of concertgoers brings the garage's count to 4 times what it was. How many cars are in the garage by evening?

Owen has 210 points in his arcade racing game save file. He loses 21 points after crashing during a tricky level. A speed-bonus multiplier then brings his score to 7 times what remained. His rival, Zeke, brags that his own best score is only a dozen points higher than what Owen started with today, though Zeke rarely bothers to check his math. Owen then earns 30 more points from a perfect lap bonus. A double-event weekend brings his score to 8 times what it had grown to. A final leaderboard bonus brings his score to 5 times what it was. How many points does Owen have now?

A classroom has 232 marbles in a shared jar at the start of the term. The teacher splits them evenly across 4 table groups, and the story follows just one table's share from here. That table then trades with another class in a way that brings their marbles to 9 times what they held. A special event afterward brings their total to 3 times what it had grown to. A final contribution from a parent volunteer adds 6 more marbles to the table's collection. How many marbles does that table have now?

Grandma Lucy has 164 photographs in an old album. She adds 25 more photos from a recent family reunion. She then removes 12 blurry photos that didn't turn out well. Her sister Edith, who keeps a separate album, has 90 photos in hers, much less than Lucy's growing collection. The photo shop, coincidentally, printed 500 photos that week for various customers. Lucy adds 24 more photos from a grandchild's graduation. She removes 23 duplicate photos she finds while organizing. How many photographs are in Lucy's album now?

A food pantry starts the week with 223 pounds of rice in storage, which the coordinator notes is just over 101 kilograms if you convert it. A distribution event removes 45 pounds to fill family food boxes. A donation from a local grocery store adds 21 more pounds. A second donation from a restaurant supplier adds 50 more pounds. A final distribution event removes 96 pounds for a weekend food drive. How many pounds of rice are left in storage?

A bookstore's clearance table has 53 paperbacks on it at the start of the day. A morning sale moves 16 books off the table. A lunchtime rush moves 19 more books. The store's manager then sets aside half of what remains for a special weekend display, and the story follows just the display's stock from here. The store's café section, meanwhile, sold 80 muffins that same day, unrelated to the book count. An afternoon restock brings the display's book count to 4 times what it held. How many books are on the display now?

A small YouTube channel starts the week with 86 subscribers. A platform-wide inactive-account purge removes 57 subscribers from the channel's count. A surprise feature on a trending page brings the channel's subscriber count to 8 times what remained. A second trending wave brings it to 7 times what it had grown to. A collaboration video with a bigger creator brings the count to 9 times what it was. The creator's older channel, started years ago, has 400,000 subscribers total, completely separate from this new channel. Afterward, 21 more people subscribe from a community post shoutout. A final small bump of 30 subscribers comes in overnight. How many subscribers does the channel have now?

A raffle box at a charity gala starts with 120 tickets inside. A last-minute rush of ticket sales brings the box's count to 2 times what it was. The organizers then draw and remove 112 tickets as the night's early prize winners are announced. A late table of guests adds 23 more tickets to the box. One of the organizers, Bianca, mentions that a separate box for the silent auction has already sold 200 tickets, more than this raffle box has now. A final matching donation brings the raffle box's tickets to 7 times what it had grown to. At the very end of the night, 696 tickets are removed as the grand prize winners are drawn. How many tickets are left in the raffle box?

In the morning, a school's recycling bin has 136 cans collected from the previous week. By midday, 116 cans are taken out and sent to the recycling center. A dozen students helped haul that first batch away, though that headcount has nothing to do with the can total. In the early afternoon, 50 more cans are added from the cafeteria's lunch recycling. By late afternoon, a school-wide collection drive brings the bin's count to 5 times what it had grown to. That evening, the janitor adds 10 more cans found around the building. How many cans are in the recycling bin now?

In the morning, a warehouse has 90 pallets of bottled juice ready to ship, weighing in at just over 9 metric tons, or about 9,900 pounds. By midday, a huge retail order brings the pallet count to 7 times what it was. In the early afternoon, a second order brings it to 3 times what it had grown to. By late afternoon, the pallets are split evenly across 3 delivery trucks, and the story follows just one truck's load from here. That evening, 464 pallets are unloaded at the truck's first delivery stop. Right before the driver's shift ends, 58 more pallets are picked up from a return pickup at a second stop. How many pallets are on that truck now?

A birdwatcher counts 16 sparrows at the backyard feeder this morning. A hawk swoops by and 9 sparrows scatter away. A dozen finches land nearby too, though they're a different species and don't count toward the sparrow tally. Later, 43 more sparrows arrive from a nearby flock. A few minutes after that, 6 more join in. By afternoon, 47 sparrows fly off toward a neighbor's feeder. Just before dusk, 2 more sparrows leave for the night. How many sparrows are at the feeder now?

A charity 5K race starts with 82 registered runners, having collected registration fees that come to 8,200 cents once you count every dollar. A late surge of sign-ups brings the runner count to 6 times what it was. A local running club registers 71 more members as a group. A partnership with a nearby gym brings the total to 3 times what it had grown to. The race director, Wanda, mentions a rival charity's race down the road only has 900 runners signed up, far fewer than her event. A final walk-up registration wave adds 52 more runners on race morning. A last-minute team sign-up brings the total to 7 times what it had reached. How many runners are registered for the race now?

In the morning, a used bookstore has 194 books on its 'buy two get one free' table. By mid-morning, 133 books are sold to a group of homeschool families. In the early afternoon, a donation brings in 58 more books. Shortly after, another 14 books are added from a customer trade-in. The store's rare books section, elsewhere in the shop, is valued at 5,000 dollars total, unrelated to this table's count. By late afternoon, 11 more books are added from a final donation box. That evening, 51 books are sold during a closing-time rush. Right before locking up, 14 more books are pulled for a damaged-cover clearance bin. How many books are on the table now?

In the morning, a food bank's shelf has 231 boxes of pasta stocked. By midday, a donation truck adds 40 more boxes. In the early afternoon, a school food drive adds 44 more boxes. By late afternoon, a grocery store's surplus donation adds 73 more boxes. The food bank's canned goods shelf, elsewhere in the building, holds 600 cans, unrelated to the pasta count. That evening, 261 boxes are distributed to families during the weekly pickup event. How many boxes of pasta are left on the shelf?

A card shop's inventory starts the month with 112 packs of trading cards. A new shipment adds 60 more packs. A big weekend sale moves 111 packs out the door. A bonus restock from the distributor brings the inventory to 8 times what remained. The shop owner, Felipe, mentions his cousin's shop across town only has 300 packs in stock, far behind his own. A convention weekend sells off 225 packs. A final bulk delivery before the holidays brings the inventory to 9 times what it had fallen to. How many packs of trading cards are in the shop now?

Grandpa Sal has 55 dollars in his coin jar, worth exactly 5,500 cents when he counts it out loud with his grandkids. He adds 69 more dollars from a garage sale over the weekend. A birthday check from his brother adds 70 more dollars. He adds 12 more dollars from returning some soda cans. His son, Tony, mentions his own savings account has 900 dollars, way more than what's in Grandpa Sal's jar. A matching contribution from his wife brings the jar to 2 times what it was. The corner store, separately, restocked 200 candy bars that same week. He then spends 31 dollars on a new fishing rod. A pension bonus brings the jar to 3 times what it had left. How much money is in Grandpa Sal's coin jar now?

Marcus begins the weekend with 122 seashells sorted into a wooden box after a long walk along the shore. Back home, he throws away 84 shells that turned out to be cracked or chipped. He then sets aside 30 shells to donate to his cousin's classroom collection. A friend visiting that evening borrows 2 shells to use in an art project. Later, the box tips over near the door and 3 shells roll under the couch and stay lost. A dozen of his neighbor's pinecones were drying on the porch railing at the same time, though that number has nothing to do with Marcus's shells. His sister mentioned that 45 people showed up at the beach cleanup that same day, a fact that does not affect his count. How many seashells does Marcus have in his box now?

In the morning, Elena has 28 stickers in her collection album. By midday, she uses 8 of them to decorate a birthday card for a friend. In the afternoon, a sticker-trading event at school brings her total to 6 times what it was after the card. Later that afternoon, a bonus pack from her teacher brings her collection to 2 times its size. Her classmate Owen, who only started collecting last month, has just 15 stickers by comparison. That evening, she trades away 58 stickers for a rare holographic one she has wanted for weeks. How many stickers does Elena have in her album now?

Priya's food truck starts the day with 103 tacos prepped for the lunch rush. A large catering order takes 28 tacos right away. A dinner rush later brings in 58 more tacos that get prepped fresh. A viral social media post that evening brings her stock to 4 times what it had grown to. Her competitor, Sam, who runs a truck two blocks away, only sells about 90 tacos on a typical night. Right before closing, a batch of 4 tacos gets burned and has to be thrown out. How many tacos does Priya have ready at the end of the night?

A warehouse begins the month with 190 crates of canned goods on its shelves. A shipment from the main distributor brings the total to 4 times what it started at. A large order from a grocery chain then takes 412 crates out for delivery. A smaller store nearby also picks up 45 crates for its weekend sale. A restock effort brings the warehouse to 5 times the crates it had left. The manager, Dana, has worked at the warehouse for 233 days this year, compared to her assistant Leo's 90. A final bulk order for a citywide festival then removes 1060 crates from the shelves. The warehouse also logged 76 visitor sign-ins that month, a number unrelated to the crate count. A dozen forklifts sat idle in the yard the whole time, though that has nothing to do with this story either. How many crates of canned goods remain in the warehouse now?

A small library starts the semester with 46 dollars in its book-fair cash box, which comes out to 4600 cents. The librarian spends 19 dollars restocking bookmarks and pencils for the fair. A batch of overdue fines waived for a promotion then costs the fund another 16 dollars. A parent donation adds 48 dollars to the box. A raffle at the fair brings in 69 more dollars. A final matching gift from the school board adds 64 dollars to the total. A dozen extra raffle tickets were printed just in case, though that number plays no role in the cash total. How many dollars are in the book-fair cash box now?

A tech startup begins the year with 33 minutes of total video content on its channel, or a little over half an hour. A viral clip that spring brings their content library to 4 times what it was. A partnership with an influencer then grows the library to 8 times its size. A summer content push brings the total to 4 times what it had grown to. A fall marketing campaign brings it to 7 times what it was by then. A final year-end binge-worthy series brings the library to 6 times its size. The channel's editor, Wen, has uploaded far more hours than her intern, Beth, who has only ever uploaded 15 minutes of footage. How many minutes of video content does the channel have by the end of the year?

In the morning, a food bank has 175 cans of soup stacked in its pantry. By midday, a massive donation drive brings the total to 2 times what it was. In the afternoon, a distribution event to local families uses up 248 cans from the shelves. A radio announcement that same afternoon mentioned 60 volunteers helping citywide, though that number has no effect on the can count. By evening, another wave of donations brings the pantry to 9 times the cans it had left. Late that evening, a final distribution to a shelter takes away 403 cans. How many cans of soup remain in the pantry?

A community garden starts spring with 186 tomato plants in the ground. A volunteer group plants 46 more seedlings the following week. A donation from a local nursery adds 47 more plants to the rows. A stretch of perfect weather brings the total number of plants to 7 times what it was. A late frost then wipes out 1166 of the weaker plants across the garden. A final donation drive adds 44 more hardy seedlings to replace some of the loss. A dozen garden gnomes were also donated that spring, though they have nothing to do with the plant count. How many tomato plants are growing in the garden now?

A bakery starts the morning with 142 loaves of bread on its shelves. A big order for a wedding takes 96 loaves right away. A regular customer buys 15 more loaves for a family event. A local cafe picks up 30 loaves for its breakfast menu. A fresh batch from the oven adds 72 more loaves to the shelves. A citywide bread festival then brings the shelf count to 7 times what it had grown to. The head baker, Rosa, has decorated a dozen wedding cakes this year, far more than her apprentice Tom's 3, though neither number affects today's loaf count. How many loaves of bread are on the bakery's shelves now?
